_note: Register fragment for the-public-and-community-surface change (ADR-037). A notice is NOT a publication: reusing `publication` for a storingsmelding would put it in the sitemap and in the DiWoo feed, which is the wrong place. The status page reads components an administrator set, and probes nothing, because a page that infers health from a health check tells the reader the monitoring is up.

serviceStatus.comment: Read on every anonymous load of the status page

statusSubscription.comment: An address is a recipient only once it confirmed; never read by an anonymous reader

instanceBanner.comment: Shown to every signed-in user between its dates

noticeBoard.comment: One board per catalogue, with comments off until somebody names a moderator

notice.comment: Deliberately not a publication: a notice never enters the sitemap or the DiWoo feed

recordVote.comment: One vote per reader token per record; the distribution is public, the votes are not

serviceStatus.title: Service status
serviceStatus.summary: One named component and the state somebody set on it
serviceStatus.description: A component a reader recognises, with its current state and a short message. An administrator sets the state, or an integration does. It is never inferred from a health probe: a status page that reads a probe tells the reader the monitoring is up, which is the failure mode every incident starts with.

component.title: Component
component.description: The name a reader recognises, not the hostname.

message.title: Message
message.description: What a reader should do about it, in a sentence.

stateSetAt.title: State set at
stateSetAt.description: When somebody last said this. Shown on the page, because a state nobody touched is not a fresh state.

statusSubscription.title: Status subscription
statusSubscription.summary: A reader who asked to be told when a component changes
statusSubscription.description: A subscription is a notification subscription under ADR-031, not a mailing list of this app's own. An anonymous reader's address is a recipient only after a one-time confirmation, because subscribing somebody else to an alert stream is a way to send mail on their behalf.

address.title: Address
address.description: Where the reader asked to be told.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: The status page or the notice board subscribed to.

confirmedAt.title: Confirmed at
confirmedAt.description: Unset until the reader confirmed. An unconfirmed subscription is never a recipient.

confirmationTokenHash.title: Confirmation token hash
confirmationTokenHash.description: A hash of the one-time token. Never the token.

instanceBanner.title: Instance banner
instanceBanner.summary: Something every signed-in user should see, between two dates
instanceBanner.description: A banner belongs to the instance, not to a catalogue, because planned maintenance is not per catalogue. It shows between its dates and to nobody outside them, and a dismissable banner a user dismissed is not shown to that user again.

noticeBoard.title: Notice board
noticeBoard.summary: A catalogue's board of dated notices
noticeBoard.description: Comments on a notice are a moderation duty, so they are off by default, and a board that enables them names a moderator. A board with comments and no moderator is refused at the save.

moderator.title: Moderator
moderator.description: Required as soon as comments are enabled.

notice.title: Notice
notice.summary: Something a municipality wants to say this week
notice.description: A publication is a document the Woo obliges us to hold; a notice is something a municipality wants to say this week. Different lifetimes, different obligations, different readers. A notice never enters the sitemap or the DiWoo feed.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: An optional link to a publication. A link to one, never a copy of one.

recordVote.title: Record vote
recordVote.summary: One reader's vote on one published record
recordVote.description: Participatie and inspraak are the use, and both are acts where the count is the point. The distribution is readable; an individual vote is not, because a vote on an inspraak item is an opinion attached to a person. The reader is held as a salted hash of their token.

readerHash.title: Reader hash
readerHash.description: A salted hash of the reader token. Never the token, and never a name.
